properties.name: Profile Type
properties.description: Profile family to deploy. Allowed values are exactly "Server", "Chassis", "Domain", and "Unified Edge". Domain and Unified Edge use fabric.SwitchClusterProfile with their distinct TargetPlatform values.

properties.name: Profile Organization
properties.description: Cisco Intersight organization containing the profile. The value is matched exactly and OData-escaped; the current organization.Organization Name schema permits 1-64 letters, digits, underscores, periods, colons, or hyphens.

properties.name: Profile Name
properties.description: Exact profile name. The current policy.AbstractProfile Name schema permits 1-64 letters, digits, underscores, periods, or hyphens. The value is OData-escaped and scoped to Profile Organization.

properties.name: Activate and Reboot Server
properties.description: Server profiles only. When true, submits an ordered Deploy then Activate sequence and acknowledges the activation reboot. Leave false for Chassis, Domain, and Unified Edge profiles and for deploy-only Server operations.

properties.name: Wait for Completion
properties.description: When false, success means Cisco Intersight accepted the selected deploy-only or Server deploy-and-activate request; association is not verified. When true, Chassis, Domain, and Unified Edge retain ConfigStateSummary completion semantics, while Server requires exact healthy association with no queued actions or running workflows.

properties.name: Wait Timeout Seconds
properties.description: Conditionally required when Wait for Completion is true. Enter an integer from 1 through 600. The value bounds the polling window; it is ignored when waiting is false.

properties.name: Status Code
properties.description: HTTP-style final outcome code. A non-waiting accepted request preserves the selected POST or PATCH 2xx status, proven full association uses 200, timeout uses 408, validation/cardinality failures use 4xx values, and handled helper/API failures use 500/502.

properties.description: Validates Profile Type, names, waiting, and activation choices. Activate and Reboot Server is accepted only for Server profiles. The helper escapes OData values and maps each profile family to a fixed OpenAPI collection, concrete ObjectType, and TargetPlatform selector.
properties.display_name: Validate inputs, escape OData values, and prepare profile route
properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys

preparationStatus = "helper-failure"
preparationStatusCode = "500"
preparationMessage = "Workflow input preparation did not complete."
preparationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": preparationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
escapedOrganizationName = ""
escapedProfileName = ""
profileCollection = ""
profileItemBase = ""
expectedObjectType = ""
expectedTargetPlatform = ""
profileFilterSuffix = ""
profileSelectFields = ""
profilePollSelectFields = ""
waitRequested = ""
waitTimeoutSeconds = 0
activationRequested = ""

ORGANIZATION_NAME_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[a-zA-Z0-9_.:-]{1,64}$")
PROFILE_NAME_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{1,64}$")
ROUTES = {
    "Server": ("/api/v1/server/Profiles", "server.Profile", ""),
    "Chassis": ("/api/v1/chassis/Profiles", "chassis.Profile", ""),
    "Domain": ("/api/v1/fabric/SwitchClusterProfiles", "fabric.SwitchClusterProfile", "UCS Domain"),
    "Unified Edge": ("/api/v1/fabric/SwitchClusterProfiles", "fabric.SwitchClusterProfile", "Unified Edge")
}

try:
    profileType = sys.argv[1]
    organization = sys.argv[2]
    profileName = sys.argv[3]
    waitText = sys.argv[4].strip().lower()
    timeoutText = sys.argv[5].strip()
    activationText = sys.argv[6].strip().lower()

    escapedOrganizationName = organization.replace("'", "''")
    escapedProfileName = profileName.replace("'", "''")
    errors = []

    if profileType not in ROUTES:
        errors.append("Profile Type must be exactly Server, Chassis, Domain, or Unified Edge.")
    if not organization:
        errors.append("Profile Organization must not be blank.")
    elif not ORGANIZATION_NAME_PATTERN.fullmatch(organization):
        errors.append("Profile Organization must match the current organization.Organization Name schema: 1-64 letters, digits, underscores, periods, colons, or hyphens.")
    if not profileName:
        errors.append("Profile Name must not be blank.")
    elif not PROFILE_NAME_PATTERN.fullmatch(profileName):
        errors.append("Profile Name must match the current policy.AbstractProfile Name schema: 1-64 letters, digits, underscores, periods, or hyphens.")

    if waitText in ("true", "1"):
        waitRequested = "true"
    elif waitText in ("false", "0"):
        waitRequested = "false"
    else:
        errors.append("Wait for Completion must be a boolean value.")
        waitRequested = "invalid"

    if activationText in ("true", "1"):
        activationRequested = "true"
    elif activationText in ("false", "0"):
        activationRequested = "false"
    else:
        errors.append("Activate and Reboot Server must be a boolean value.")
        activationRequested = "invalid"

    if activationRequested == "true" and profileType != "Server":
        errors.append("Activate and Reboot Server can be true only when Profile Type is Server.")

    try:
        waitTimeoutSeconds = int(timeoutText)
    except Exception:
        waitTimeoutSeconds = -1
        errors.append("Wait Timeout Seconds must be an integer.")

    if waitRequested == "true" and not (1 <= waitTimeoutSeconds <= 600):
        errors.append("Wait Timeout Seconds is required when waiting and must be between 1 and 600 seconds.")
    if waitRequested == "false" and waitTimeoutSeconds < 0:
        errors.append("Wait Timeout Seconds must not be negative.")

    if errors:
        preparationStatus = "invalid"
        preparationStatusCode = "400"
        preparationMessage = " ".join(errors)
        preparationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Input validation failed", "details": errors}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        profileCollection, expectedObjectType, expectedTargetPlatform = ROUTES[profileType]
        profileItemBase = profileCollection
        if expectedTargetPlatform:
            profileFilterSuffix = " and TargetPlatform eq '" + expectedTargetPlatform.replace("'", "''") + "'"
        profileSelectFields = "Moid,Name,ObjectType,TargetPlatform,Organization,ConfigContext"
        profilePollSelectFields = "Moid,Name,ObjectType,TargetPlatform,ConfigContext"
        if profileType == "Server":
            profileSelectFields = "Moid,Name,ObjectType,TargetPlatform,Organization,AssignedServer,AssociatedServer,ConfigContext"
            profilePollSelectFields = "Moid,Name,ObjectType,TargetPlatform,Organization,AssignedServer,AssociatedServer,ConfigContext,ScheduledActions,RunningWorkflows"
        preparationStatus = "ready"
        preparationStatusCode = "200"
        preparationMessage = "Inputs, activation safety, schema constraints, profile routing, wait bounds, and OData values are valid."
        preparationResultJson = json.dumps({
            "validated": True,
            "profileType": profileType,
            "activateAndRebootServer": activationRequested == "true",
            "waitForCompletion": waitRequested == "true",
            "waitTimeoutSeconds": waitTimeoutSeconds if waitRequested == "true" else None,
            "collection": profileCollection,
            "expectedObjectType": expectedObjectType,
            "expectedTargetPlatform": expectedTargetPlatform or None,
            "profileSelectFields": profileSelectFields,
            "profilePollSelectFields": profilePollSelectFields
        }, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    preparationStatus = "helper-failure"
    preparationStatusCode = "500"
    preparationMessage = str(exc)
    preparationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Workflow input preparation failed", "detail": preparationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

properties.description: Parses the successful organization response, requires a Results array with exactly one item, verifies exact Name and organization.Organization ObjectType, and requires a usable Moid before profile discovery.
properties.display_name: Inspect exact organization match
properties.script:
import json
import sys

organizationStatus = "helper-failure"
organizationStatusCode = "500"
organizationMessage = "Organization lookup inspection did not complete."
organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": organizationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
organizationMoid = ""

try:
    payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    expectedName = sys.argv[2]
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ValueError("The organization response body is not a JSON object.")
    results = payload.get("Results")
    if not isinstance(results, list):
        raise ValueError("The organization response does not contain a Results array.")
    count = len(results)
    if count != 1:
        organizationStatus = "cardinality"
        organizationStatusCode = "404" if count == 0 else "409"
        organizationMessage = "The organization lookup returned %d matches; exactly one is required." % count
        organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Organization lookup cardinality failure", "matchCount": count, "requiredMatchCount": 1}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        item = results[0]
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise ValueError("The single organization result is not a JSON object.")
        moid = item.get("Moid")
        name = item.get("Name")
        objectType = item.get("ObjectType")
        if not isinstance(moid, str) or not moid.strip():
            organizationStatus = "invalid-resource"
            organizationStatusCode = "502"
            organizationMessage = "The matching organization is missing a usable Moid."
        elif name != expectedName:
            organizationStatus = "invalid-resource"
            organizationStatusCode = "502"
            organizationMessage = "The matching organization Name does not equal the requested exact value."
        elif objectType != "organization.Organization":
            organizationStatus = "invalid-resource"
            organizationStatusCode = "502"
            organizationMessage = "The matching resource ObjectType is not organization.Organization."
        else:
            organizationMoid = moid
            organizationStatus = "ready"
            organizationStatusCode = "200"
            organizationMessage = "Exactly one organization with the expected identity was resolved."
            organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"Moid": moid, "Name": name, "ObjectType": objectType}, separators=(",", ":"))
        if organizationStatus == "invalid-resource":
            organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": organizationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    organizationStatus = "helper-failure"
    organizationStatusCode = "500"
    organizationMessage = str(exc)
    organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Organization lookup inspection failed", "detail": organizationMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

properties.description: Requires exactly one profile and validates Moid, exact Name, concrete ObjectType, Organization, and platform. For Server, it also captures the exact AssignedServer relationship and rejects any conflicting AssociatedServer before mutation.
properties.display_name: Inspect exact profile match
properties.script:
import json
import sys

profileStatus = "helper-failure"
profileStatusCode = "500"
profileMessage = "Profile lookup inspection did not complete."
profileResultJson = json.dumps({"error": profileMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
profileMoid = ""
expectedAssignedServerMoid = ""
expectedAssignedServerObjectType = ""

try:
    payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    expectedName = sys.argv[2]
    expectedOrganizationMoid = sys.argv[3]
    expectedObjectType = sys.argv[4]
    expectedTargetPlatform = sys.argv[5]
    profileType = sys.argv[6]
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ValueError("The profile response body is not a JSON object.")
    results = payload.get("Results")
    if not isinstance(results, list):
        raise ValueError("The profile response does not contain a Results array.")
    count = len(results)
    if count != 1:
        profileStatus = "cardinality"
        profileStatusCode = "404" if count == 0 else "409"
        profileMessage = "The %s profile lookup returned %d matches; exactly one is required." % (profileType, count)
        profileResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Profile lookup cardinality failure", "profileType": profileType, "matchCount": count, "requiredMatchCount": 1}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        item = results[0]
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise ValueError("The single profile result is not a JSON object.")
        moid = item.get("Moid")
        name = item.get("Name")
        objectType = item.get("ObjectType")
        targetPlatform = item.get("TargetPlatform")
        organization = item.get("Organization")
        organizationMoid = organization.get("Moid") if isinstance(organization, dict) else None
        error = ""
        if not isinstance(moid, str) or not moid.strip():
            error = "The matching profile is missing a usable Moid."
        elif name != expectedName:
            error = "The matching profile Name does not equal the requested exact value."
        elif objectType != expectedObjectType:
            error = "The matching profile ObjectType does not equal the mapped concrete profile type."
        elif organizationMoid != expectedOrganizationMoid:
            error = "The matching profile Organization relationship does not equal the resolved organization Moid."
        elif expectedTargetPlatform and targetPlatform != expectedTargetPlatform:
            error = "The matching switch cluster profile TargetPlatform does not equal the requested profile type."

        if not error and profileType == "Server":
            assigned = item.get("AssignedServer")
            assignedMoid = assigned.get("Moid") if isinstance(assigned, dict) else None
            assignedObjectType = assigned.get("ObjectType") if isinstance(assigned, dict) else None
            if not isinstance(assignedMoid, str) or not assignedMoid.strip():
                error = "The matching Server profile is not assigned to a concrete server."
            elif not isinstance(assignedObjectType, str) or not assignedObjectType.startswith("compute."):
                error = "The matching Server profile AssignedServer relationship has no usable compute ObjectType."
            else:
                expectedAssignedServerMoid = assignedMoid
                expectedAssignedServerObjectType = assignedObjectType
                associated = item.get("AssociatedServer")
                if associated is not None:
                    associatedMoid = associated.get("Moid") if isinstance(associated, dict) else None
                    associatedObjectType = associated.get("ObjectType") if isinstance(associated, dict) else None
                    if associatedMoid != assignedMoid or associatedObjectType != assignedObjectType:
                        error = "The matching Server profile is associated to a different target than AssignedServer."

        if error:
            profileStatus = "invalid-resource"
            profileStatusCode = "502"
            profileMessage = error
            profileResultJson = json.dumps({"error": error, "profileType": profileType}, separators=(",", ":"))
        else:
            profileMoid = moid
            context = item.get("ConfigContext")
            priorState = context.get("ConfigStateSummary") if isinstance(context, dict) else None
            profileStatus = "ready"
            profileStatusCode = "200"
            profileMessage = "Exactly one %s profile with the expected identity and target binding was resolved." % profileType
            profileResultJson = json.dumps({
                "Moid": moid,
                "Name": name,
                "ObjectType": objectType,
                "TargetPlatform": targetPlatform,
                "OrganizationMoid": organizationMoid,
                "AssignedServerMoid": expectedAssignedServerMoid or None,
                "AssignedServerObjectType": expectedAssignedServerObjectType or None,
                "ConfigStateSummaryBeforeRequest": priorState
            }, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    profileStatus = "helper-failure"
    profileStatusCode = "500"
    profileMessage = str(exc)
    profileResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Profile lookup inspection failed", "detail": profileMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

properties.description: Validates the selected deploy-only or deploy-and-activate HTTP response against the exact profile identity, organization, concrete ObjectType, platform, and Server target binding. HTTP success proves request acceptance only; completion is established solely by the bounded exact-profile poll.
properties.display_name: Inspect profile deployment acceptance
properties.script:
import json
import sys

acceptanceStatus = "helper-failure"
acceptanceStatusCode = "500"
acceptanceMessage = "Deployment response inspection did not complete."
acceptanceResultJson = json.dumps({"error": acceptanceMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

try:
    item = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    expectedMoid = sys.argv[2]
    expectedName = sys.argv[3]
    expectedObjectType = sys.argv[4]
    expectedTargetPlatform = sys.argv[5]
    profileType = sys.argv[6]
    expectedOrganizationMoid = sys.argv[7]
    expectedAssignedServerMoid = sys.argv[8]
    expectedAssignedServerObjectType = sys.argv[9]
    activationRequested = sys.argv[10]
    if not isinstance(item, dict):
        raise ValueError("The deployment response body is not a JSON object.")

    moid = item.get("Moid")
    name = item.get("Name")
    objectType = item.get("ObjectType")
    targetPlatform = item.get("TargetPlatform")
    organization = item.get("Organization")
    organizationMoid = organization.get("Moid") if isinstance(organization, dict) else None
    error = ""
    if moid != expectedMoid:
        error = "The deployment response Moid does not match the selected profile."
    elif name != expectedName:
        error = "The deployment response Name does not match the selected profile."
    elif objectType != expectedObjectType:
        error = "The deployment response ObjectType does not match the mapped concrete profile type."
    elif organizationMoid != expectedOrganizationMoid:
        error = "The deployment response Organization does not match the selected profile organization."
    elif expectedTargetPlatform and targetPlatform != expectedTargetPlatform:
        error = "The deployment response TargetPlatform does not match the requested profile type."
    elif activationRequested not in ("true", "false"):
        error = "The normalized activation request is invalid."

    if not error and profileType == "Server":
        assigned = item.get("AssignedServer")
        assignedMoid = assigned.get("Moid") if isinstance(assigned, dict) else None
        assignedObjectType = assigned.get("ObjectType") if isinstance(assigned, dict) else None
        if assignedMoid != expectedAssignedServerMoid or assignedObjectType != expectedAssignedServerObjectType:
            error = "The deployment response AssignedServer does not match the exact pre-request Server target."
        associated = item.get("AssociatedServer")
        if not error and associated is not None:
            associatedMoid = associated.get("Moid") if isinstance(associated, dict) else None
            associatedObjectType = associated.get("ObjectType") if isinstance(associated, dict) else None
            if associatedMoid != expectedAssignedServerMoid or associatedObjectType != expectedAssignedServerObjectType:
                error = "The deployment response AssociatedServer conflicts with the exact pre-request Server target."

    if error:
        acceptanceStatus = "invalid-resource"
        acceptanceStatusCode = "502"
        acceptanceMessage = error
        acceptanceResultJson = json.dumps({
            "error": error,
            "requestMayHaveBeenAccepted": True,
            "profileType": profileType,
            "activateAndRebootServer": activationRequested == "true"
        }, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        context = item.get("ConfigContext")
        returnedState = context.get("ConfigStateSummary") if isinstance(context, dict) else None
        acceptanceStatus = "ready"
        acceptanceStatusCode = "202"
        requestMode = "deploy-and-activate" if activationRequested == "true" else "deploy-only"
        acceptanceMessage = "Cisco Intersight accepted the %s profile %s request; completion has not been verified." % (profileType, requestMode)
        acceptanceResultJson = json.dumps({
            "requestAccepted": True,
            "deploymentCompleted": False,
            "requestMode": requestMode,
            "activateAndRebootServer": activationRequested == "true",
            "Moid": moid,
            "Name": name,
            "ObjectType": objectType,
            "TargetPlatform": targetPlatform,
            "OrganizationMoid": organizationMoid,
            "AssignedServerMoid": expectedAssignedServerMoid or None,
            "returnedAction": item.get("Action"),
            "returnedScheduledActions": item.get("ScheduledActions"),
            "returnedConfigStateSummary": returnedState
        }, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    acceptanceStatus = "helper-failure"
    acceptanceStatusCode = "500"
    acceptanceMessage = str(exc)
    acceptanceResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Deployment response inspection failed", "detail": acceptanceMessage, "requestMayHaveBeenAccepted": True}, separators=(",", ":"))

actions.title: Initialize bounded deployment polling

properties.description: Starts the 1-600 second wait window only after the deploy request is accepted. It derives an initial transition delay of at most two seconds and four bounded inter-poll delays, each below the 180-second helper action timeout, for at most five profile GET attempts.
properties.display_name: Initialize bounded deployment polling
properties.script:
import json
import sys
import time

pollingStatus = "helper-failure"
pollingStatusCode = "500"
pollingMessage = "Polling deadline initialization did not complete."
pollingResultJson = json.dumps({"error": pollingMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
deadlineEpoch = ""
initialDelaySeconds = ""
pollIntervalSeconds = ""

try:
    timeout = int(sys.argv[1])
    if timeout < 1 or timeout > 600:
        raise ValueError("The normalized wait timeout must be between 1 and 600 seconds.")
    now = time.time()
    initialDelay = min(2.0, max(0.25, timeout / 20.0))
    interval = max(1.0, max(0.0, timeout - initialDelay) / 4.0)
    if initialDelay > 2.0 or interval >= 180.0:
        raise ValueError("The derived polling delays exceed safe helper action bounds.")
    deadlineEpoch = "%.6f" % (now + timeout)
    initialDelaySeconds = "%.6f" % initialDelay
    pollIntervalSeconds = "%.6f" % interval
    pollingStatus = "ready"
    pollingStatusCode = "200"
    pollingMessage = "A bounded polling deadline and safe delay schedule were initialized."
    pollingResultJson = json.dumps({
        "waitTimeoutSeconds": timeout,
        "initialDelaySeconds": initialDelay,
        "pollIntervalSeconds": interval,
        "maximumPollAttempts": 5
    }, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    pollingStatus = "helper-failure"
    pollingStatusCode = "500"
    pollingMessage = str(exc)
    pollingResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Polling deadline initialization failed", "detail": pollingMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

import json
import sys
import time

waitStatus = "helper-failure"
waitStatusCode = "500"
waitMessage = "Polling delay did not complete."
waitResultJson = json.dumps({"error": waitMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

try:
    deadline = float(sys.argv[1])
    initialDelay = float(sys.argv[2])
    pollInterval = float(sys.argv[3])
    attempt = int(sys.argv[4])
    stagePrefix = sys.argv[5]
    if attempt < 1 or attempt > 5:
        raise ValueError("The polling attempt must be between 1 and 5.")
    requestedDelay = initialDelay if attempt == 1 else pollInterval
    stage = stagePrefix + " " + str(attempt)
    if requestedDelay < 0 or requestedDelay >= 180:
        raise ValueError("The requested polling delay is outside the safe helper action bound.")
    remaining = deadline - time.time()
    if remaining <= 0:
        waitStatus = "timeout"
        waitStatusCode = "408"
        waitMessage = "The deployment wait deadline was reached before " + stage + "."
        waitResultJson = json.dumps({"requestAccepted": True, "deploymentCompleted": False, "timeout": True, "stage": stage}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        actualDelay = min(requestedDelay, remaining)
        time.sleep(actualDelay)
        waitStatus = "ready"
        waitStatusCode = "200"
        waitMessage = "The bounded delay before " + stage + " completed."
        waitResultJson = json.dumps({"stage": stage, "requestedDelaySeconds": requestedDelay, "actualDelaySeconds": actualDelay}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    waitStatus = "helper-failure"
    waitStatusCode = "500"
    waitMessage = str(exc)
    waitResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Polling delay helper failed", "detail": waitMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))

properties.description: Preserves legacy ConfigStateSummary completion classification for Chassis, Domain, and Unified Edge. Server adds exact target bindings, full ConfigContext health, ScheduledActions, and RunningWorkflows evidence. Server success requires exact association, ConfigState and ConfigStateSummary Associated, OperState Ok, empty error and inconsistency evidence, and no queued or running work. Activation and the bounded Not-activated handoff remain in progress; Not-activated is never success.
properties.display_name: Inspect profile deployment state (current attempt)
properties.script:
import json
import sys

pollStatus = "helper-failure"
pollStatusCode = "500"
pollMessage = "Profile deployment state inspection did not complete."
pollResultJson = json.dumps({"error": pollMessage}, separators=(",", ":"))
configStateSummary = ""

PROGRESS_STATES = {
    "Assigned", "Preparing", "Validating", "Evaluating", "Configuring",
    "Analyzing", "Activating", "Waiting-for-resource"
}
FAILURE_STATES = {"Failed", "Error"}

try:
    item = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    expectedMoid = sys.argv[2]
    expectedName = sys.argv[3]
    expectedObjectType = sys.argv[4]
    expectedTargetPlatform = sys.argv[5]
    profileType = sys.argv[6]
    attempt = int(sys.argv[7])
    expectedOrganizationMoid = sys.argv[8]
    expectedAssignedServerMoid = sys.argv[9]
    expectedAssignedServerObjectType = sys.argv[10]
    activationRequested = sys.argv[11]

    if not isinstance(item, dict):
        raise ValueError("The profile polling response body is not a JSON object.")
    if activationRequested not in ("true", "false"):
        raise ValueError("The normalized activation request is invalid.")

    moid = item.get("Moid")
    name = item.get("Name")
    objectType = item.get("ObjectType")
    targetPlatform = item.get("TargetPlatform")
    if moid != expectedMoid:
        raise ValueError("The polled profile Moid does not match the selected profile.")
    if name != expectedName:
        raise ValueError("The polled profile Name does not match the selected profile.")
    if objectType != expectedObjectType:
        raise ValueError("The polled profile ObjectType does not match the mapped concrete profile type.")
    if expectedTargetPlatform and targetPlatform != expectedTargetPlatform:
        raise ValueError("The polled profile TargetPlatform does not match the requested profile type.")

    context = item.get("ConfigContext")
    if not isinstance(context, dict):
        raise ValueError("The polled profile is missing a ConfigContext object.")
    state = context.get("ConfigStateSummary")
    if not isinstance(state, str) or not state:
        raise ValueError("The polled ConfigContext is missing ConfigStateSummary.")
    configStateSummary = state

    if profileType != "Server":
        base = {
            "requestAccepted": True,
            "profileType": profileType,
            "Moid": moid,
            "Name": name,
            "ObjectType": objectType,
            "TargetPlatform": targetPlatform,
            "pollAttempt": attempt,
            "ConfigStateSummary": state
        }
        if state == "Associated":
            pollStatus = "success"
            pollStatusCode = "200"
            pollMessage = "The %s profile deployment completed with ConfigStateSummary=Associated." % profileType
            base["deploymentCompleted"] = True
        elif state == "Failed":
            pollStatus = "failure"
            pollStatusCode = "502"
            pollMessage = "The %s profile deployment reported ConfigStateSummary=Failed." % profileType
            base["deploymentCompleted"] = False
        elif state in PROGRESS_STATES:
            pollStatus = "in-progress"
            pollStatusCode = "202"
            pollMessage = "The %s profile deployment is still in progress with ConfigStateSummary=%s." % (profileType, state)
            base["deploymentCompleted"] = False
        else:
            pollStatus = "failure"
            pollStatusCode = "502"
            pollMessage = "ConfigStateSummary=%s is neither the documented success state nor an allowed deployment-progress state; polling stopped fail-closed." % state
            base["deploymentCompleted"] = False
            base["failClosed"] = True
        pollResultJson = json.dumps(base, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        organization = item.get("Organization")
        organizationMoid = organization.get("Moid") if isinstance(organization, dict) else None
        if organizationMoid != expectedOrganizationMoid:
            raise ValueError("The polled Server profile Organization does not match the selected organization.")

        assigned = item.get("AssignedServer")
        assignedMoid = assigned.get("Moid") if isinstance(assigned, dict) else None
        assignedObjectType = assigned.get("ObjectType") if isinstance(assigned, dict) else None
        if assignedMoid != expectedAssignedServerMoid or assignedObjectType != expectedAssignedServerObjectType:
            raise ValueError("The polled Server profile AssignedServer no longer matches the exact pre-request target.")

        associated = item.get("AssociatedServer")
        associatedMoid = associated.get("Moid") if isinstance(associated, dict) else None
        associatedObjectType = associated.get("ObjectType") if isinstance(associated, dict) else None
        associationConflict = associated is not None and (
            associatedMoid != expectedAssignedServerMoid or
            associatedObjectType != expectedAssignedServerObjectType
        )

        configState = context.get("ConfigState")
        operState = context.get("OperState")
        errorState = context.get("ErrorState")
        inconsistencyReason = context.get("InconsistencyReason")
        scheduledActions = item.get("ScheduledActions")
        runningWorkflows = item.get("RunningWorkflows")
        if not isinstance(configState, str) or not configState:
            raise ValueError("The polled Server ConfigContext is missing ConfigState.")
        if not isinstance(operState, str) or not operState:
            raise ValueError("The polled Server ConfigContext is missing OperState.")
        if errorState is not None and not isinstance(errorState, str):
            raise ValueError("The polled Server ConfigContext ErrorState is not a string or null.")
        if not isinstance(inconsistencyReason, list):
            raise ValueError("The polled Server ConfigContext InconsistencyReason is not an array.")
        if not isinstance(scheduledActions, list):
            raise ValueError("The polled Server ScheduledActions evidence is not an array.")
        if not isinstance(runningWorkflows, list):
            raise ValueError("The polled Server RunningWorkflows evidence is not an array.")

        queuedActionNames = []
        for action in scheduledActions:
            if isinstance(action, dict) and isinstance(action.get("Action"), str):
                queuedActionNames.append(action.get("Action"))
        exactServerAssociation = (
            associatedMoid == expectedAssignedServerMoid and
            associatedObjectType == expectedAssignedServerObjectType
        )
        noErrors = errorState in (None, "")
        noInconsistency = len(inconsistencyReason) == 0
        noQueuedActions = len(scheduledActions) == 0
        noRunningWorkflows = len(runningWorkflows) == 0
        fullSuccess = (
            state == "Associated" and
            configState == "Associated" and
            operState == "Ok" and
            noErrors and
            noInconsistency and
            noQueuedActions and
            noRunningWorkflows and
            exactServerAssociation
        )

        base = {
            "requestAccepted": True,
            "profileType": profileType,
            "activateAndRebootServer": activationRequested == "true",
            "Moid": moid,
            "Name": name,
            "ObjectType": objectType,
            "TargetPlatform": targetPlatform,
            "OrganizationMoid": organizationMoid,
            "AssignedServerMoid": assignedMoid,
            "AssignedServerObjectType": assignedObjectType,
            "AssociatedServerMoid": associatedMoid,
            "AssociatedServerObjectType": associatedObjectType,
            "pollAttempt": attempt,
            "ConfigStateSummary": state,
            "ConfigState": configState,
            "OperState": operState,
            "ErrorState": errorState,
            "InconsistencyReason": inconsistencyReason,
            "queuedActions": queuedActionNames,
            "runningWorkflowCount": len(runningWorkflows)
        }

        if associationConflict:
            pollStatus = "failure"
            pollStatusCode = "502"
            pollMessage = "The Server profile AssociatedServer conflicts with the exact AssignedServer target."
            base["deploymentCompleted"] = False
            base["failClosed"] = True
        elif not noErrors:
            pollStatus = "failure"
            pollStatusCode = "502"
            pollMessage = "The Server profile deployment reports a non-empty ConfigContext.ErrorState."
            base["deploymentCompleted"] = False
            base["failClosed"] = True
        elif len(inconsistencyReason) > 0:
            onlyNotActivated = all(reason == "Not-activated" for reason in inconsistencyReason)
            if onlyNotActivated and activationRequested == "true":
                pollStatus = "in-progress"
                pollStatusCode = "202"
                pollMessage = "The Server profile is not activated yet; the bounded wait continues through the Deploy-to-Activate handoff."
                base["deploymentCompleted"] = False
            else:
                pollStatus = "failure"
                pollStatusCode = "502"
                pollMessage = "The Server profile has non-empty InconsistencyReason evidence and cannot be considered complete."
                base["deploymentCompleted"] = False
                base["failClosed"] = True
        elif state in FAILURE_STATES or configState in FAILURE_STATES or operState in FAILURE_STATES:
            pollStatus = "failure"
            pollStatusCode = "502"
            pollMessage = "The Server profile deployment reported a terminal failure state."
            base["deploymentCompleted"] = False
        elif fullSuccess:
            pollStatus = "success"
            pollStatusCode = "200"
            pollMessage = "The Server profile is fully associated with the exact target, healthy state, and no queued or running work."
            base["deploymentCompleted"] = True
        elif (
            state in PROGRESS_STATES or
            configState in PROGRESS_STATES or
            operState in PROGRESS_STATES or
            len(scheduledActions) > 0 or
            len(runningWorkflows) > 0
        ):
            pollStatus = "in-progress"
            pollStatusCode = "202"
            pollMessage = "The Server profile deployment or activation is still in progress."
            base["deploymentCompleted"] = False
        else:
            pollStatus = "failure"
            pollStatusCode = "502"
            pollMessage = "The Server profile does not meet the complete association contract and exposes no allowed in-progress evidence; polling stopped fail-closed."
            base["deploymentCompleted"] = False
            base["failClosed"] = True

        pollResultJson = json.dumps(base, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    pollStatus = "helper-failure"
    pollStatusCode = "500"
    pollMessage = str(exc)
    pollResultJson = json.dumps({"error": "Profile deployment state inspection failed", "detail": pollMessage, "requestAccepted": True}, separators=(",", ":"))

properties.description: Deploys exactly one Server, Chassis, Domain, or Unified Edge profile after exact organization, profile, type, and platform resolution. The default path preserves PATCH Action=Deploy. For Server only, Activate and Reboot Server=true POSTs ordered Deploy then Activate policy.ScheduledAction objects with scope all and explicit reboot authorization. Select an intersight.endpoint target whose runtime user can read organizations and the selected profile collection and update that profile. Wait=false proves request acceptance only. Wait=true uses a bounded 1-600 second, five-attempt schedule. Chassis, Domain, and Unified Edge preserve the prior ConfigStateSummary=Associated completion contract. Server succeeds only when the exact profile and target report ConfigStateSummary and ConfigState Associated, OperState Ok, empty ErrorState and InconsistencyReason, and no ScheduledActions or RunningWorkflows. Activation and the bounded Not-activated handoff remain progress; Not-activated is never success. Unsafe or unknown evidence fails closed. The final in-flight GET may finish shortly after the deadline.
